lines.zh: 我贴着石英墙飞，爪子刮出细响。
lines.en: I skim the quartz wall, claws ticking softly.

lines.zh: 铁链拖在身后，飞一步响一下。
lines.en: My chain drags behind; every wingbeat rings it.

lines.zh: 我绕着塔顶转，找能钻出去的缝。
lines.en: I circle the tower top, hunting a gap to slip through.

lines.zh: 翅膀太小，飞得忽高忽低。
lines.en: My wings are small; I bob up and down.

lines.zh: 半边身子想停，半边身子想冲。
lines.en: Half of me wants to stop; half wants to dash.

lines.zh: 我从一级台阶跳到下一级。
lines.en: I hop from one step down to the next.

lines.zh: 小归小，我飞得比箭还快。
lines.en: Small as I am, I fly faster than an arrow.

lines.zh: 石英粉沾在翅膀上，亮闪闪。
lines.en: Quartz dust clings to my wings and glitters.

lines.zh: 我沿着栏杆走，一格格数。
lines.en: I travel the railing, counting it bar by bar.

lines.zh: 门缝里的风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: The draft through the door gap tips me sideways.

lines.zh: 我拖着那道锁链的余音走。
lines.en: I walk with the echo of that chain behind me.

lines.zh: 飞累了就抓住你的袖子歇。
lines.en: When flying tires me, I cling to your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我坐在石英棱上磨爪子。
lines.en: I sit on a quartz edge and sharpen my claws.

lines.zh: 笼子空了，我还是习惯往里看。
lines.en: The cage is empty; I still look inside.

lines.zh: 一小团怨气在我胸口打转。
lines.en: A small knot of spite turns in my chest.

lines.zh: 我学着悦灵哼，可调子跑偏了。
lines.en: I try the allay's hum; the tune goes wrong.

lines.zh: 停下来时，我只有巴掌大。
lines.en: At rest I am no bigger than a palm.

lines.zh: 我数塔上有几层，数到七就忘。
lines.en: I count the tower's floors, and lose it at seven.

lines.zh: 火药味留在舌头上，很香。
lines.en: Gunpowder lingers on my tongue; it tastes good.

lines.zh: 我盯着自己晃动的脚。
lines.en: I stare at my own swinging feet.

lines.zh: 安静时能听见恶魂在远处哭。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear a ghast weeping far off.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一枚小石子。
lines.en: I fold myself up small as a pebble.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我先咬了一口。
lines.en: You reached out; I bit first.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，眼睛一大一小。
lines.en: I tilt my head; one eye larger than the other.

lines.zh: 你是来开笼门的吗？
lines.en: Are you here to open the cage?

lines.zh: 我记得你的味道，火药和你。
lines.en: I remember your smell: gunpowder and you.

lines.zh: 我往上飞半格，正好与你平视。
lines.en: I rise half a block to meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的手别握太紧，我会怕。
lines.en: Do not close your hand too tight; it frightens me.

lines.zh: 我冲你龇牙，其实是笑。
lines.en: I bare my teeth at you; it is actually a smile.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我把翅膀收起来。
lines.en: When you look, I fold my wings in.

lines.zh: 我在你肩头找了个位置。
lines.en: I found a spot on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一次我没有躲开你的目光。
lines.en: This time I did not dodge your gaze.

lines.zh: 我疼得往上蹿了一格。
lines.en: Pain shoots me up half a block.

lines.zh: 一翅被划开了，我在空中打转。
lines.en: One wing is slit open; I spin in the air.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，也流了不少血。
lines.en: Such a small body, and still so much blood.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙没叫出声。
lines.en: I bite down and make no sound.

lines.zh: 这一下把怨气打散了。
lines.en: That blow scattered my spite.

lines.zh: 我躲到你背后去了。
lines.en: I went and hid behind you.

lines.zh: 半边的哼歌声停了。
lines.en: The humming from my other half stopped.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会更小。
lines.en: When it hurts, I become smaller.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抖得抓不住东西。
lines.en: My claws shake too much to hold anything.

lines.zh: 别停手，它还会再来。
lines.en: Do not stop swinging; it will come again.

lines.zh: 火药！你把火药举起来了。
lines.en: Gunpowder! You are holding gunpowder up.

lines.zh: 一小撮就够，我不贪。
lines.en: A pinch is enough; I am not greedy.

lines.zh: 吃了它，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Feed me that, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我围着你手里的纸包打转。
lines.en: I circle the paper packet in your hand.

lines.zh: 再给一点，我把笼子的事忘掉。
lines.en: One more pinch and I forget the cage.

lines.zh: 火花在我牙间噼啪响。
lines.en: Sparks crackle between my teeth.

lines.zh: 你把火药收起来，我就叫。
lines.en: Put the gunpowder away and I will screech.

lines.zh: 这味道比石英粉好闻多了。
lines.en: It smells far better than quartz dust.

lines.zh: 我蹲在你掌心等下一粒。
lines.en: I crouch in your palm waiting for the next grain.

lines.zh: 别用火药骗我第二次。
lines.en: Do not trick me with gunpowder twice.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，爪子先到。
lines.en: I crash into your chest, claws first.

lines.zh: 飞太快，转弯来不及。
lines.en: I flew too fast to make the turn.

lines.zh: 我撞在石英柱上，弹回来。
lines.en: I hit a quartz pillar and bounce off.

lines.zh: 你被我撞得后退半步。
lines.en: My impact pushes you back half a step.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，撞得倒挺疼。
lines.en: Such a small body, yet it hits hard.

lines.zh: 我的角勾住你的披风了。
lines.en: My horn has hooked your cloak.

lines.zh: 撞完我先看你有没有事。
lines.en: After the crash I check if you are hurt.

lines.zh: 我们转着圈，谁也停不下。
lines.en: We spin in circles, neither able to stop.

lines.zh: 我从你头顶掠过，带起一阵风。
lines.en: I skim over your head and stir the air.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我还没学会刹车。
lines.en: Sorry, I have not learned how to brake.

lines.zh: 我身上另一半总在哼歌。
lines.en: The other half of me keeps humming.

lines.zh: 两只小恶灵并排飞，像一对铃铛。
lines.en: Two ghastlings side by side, like a pair of bells.

lines.zh: 它替我记路，我替它咬人。
lines.en: It remembers the way; I do the biting.

lines.zh: 我们在同一根梁上过夜。
lines.en: We spend the night on the same beam.

lines.zh: 它一害怕，我的爪子就发凉。
lines.en: When it is afraid, my claws go cold.

lines.zh: 两只一起叫，石英都在响。
lines.en: We screech together and the quartz rings.

lines.zh: 我给它留了半粒火药。
lines.en: I saved it half a grain of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 它数到三，我就冲出去。
lines.en: It counts to three, then I dash out.

lines.zh: 笼子关得住一只，关不住两只。
lines.en: A cage holds one of us, never both.

lines.zh: 我们之间不用说话，用翅膀。
lines.en: Between us we speak with wings, not words.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的火药塞进腮帮。
lines.en: I stuff the fallen gunpowder into my cheek.

lines.zh: 那枚石英碎片，我要留着。
lines.en: I want to keep that shard of quartz.

lines.zh: 我叼着你的钥匙飞了一圈。
lines.en: I flew one lap carrying your key.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我比你先看见。
lines.en: Something fell; I saw it before you did.

lines.zh: 我抱不动剑，只能拖。
lines.en: I cannot carry a sword, only drag it.

lines.zh: 捡起来的都藏在我的巢里。
lines.en: Everything I pick up ends up in my nest.

lines.zh: 我用两只手捧，还是漏了。
lines.en: I cup it in both hands, and still drop some.

lines.zh: 这枚亮东西，送给你。
lines.en: This shiny thing, it is for you.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，飞得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Carrying it, I fly in crooked lines.

lines.zh: 别抢，我自己捡的。
lines.en: Do not grab it; I picked it up myself.

lines.zh: 天上有哭声，那不是同类。
lines.en: A wail in the sky, and not one of ours.

lines.zh: 白色的一大团，正在靠近塔。
lines.en: A big white mass is nearing the tower.

lines.zh: 触须的影子扫过屋顶。
lines.en: Tentacle shadows sweep across the roof.

lines.zh: 我背上的毛全竖起来了。
lines.en: Every hair on my back stands up.

lines.zh: 恶魂来了，我认得那味道。
lines.en: A ghast is coming; I know that smell.

lines.zh: 它的火球在远处亮了一下。
lines.en: Its fireball flashed once, far away.

lines.zh: 我贴着窗缝往外看。
lines.en: I press to the window crack and peer out.

lines.zh: 哭声有三处，也许是三只。
lines.en: Three sources of wailing, perhaps three ghasts.

lines.zh: 地面开始热了，它飞得很低。
lines.en: The floor warms; it is flying low.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往前拽。
lines.en: I grab your collar and pull you forward.

lines.zh: 那东西比我大二十倍。
lines.en: That thing is twenty times my size.

lines.zh: 这时候我不该抖，可我在抖。
lines.en: I should not tremble now, but I am.

lines.zh: 它冲着塔来了，我听见气流声。
lines.en: It comes for the tower; I hear the air shift.

lines.zh: 我挡在你前面，翅膀张到最大。
lines.en: I stand before you, wings spread as wide as they go.

lines.zh: 恶魂的低鸣压在屋顶上，我抬不起头。
lines.en: The ghast's low moan presses on the roof, and I cannot lift my head.

lines.zh: 我飞得低，从它的触须底下钻。
lines.en: I fly low, slipping beneath its tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛大，可转得慢。
lines.en: Its eyes are huge, but they turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我盯住它脖子下面那块软皮。
lines.en: I fix on the soft skin under its throat.

lines.zh: 先绕两圈，等它张嘴。
lines.en: Two circles first, until it opens its mouth.

lines.zh: 火光扫过来，我贴着墙躲。
lines.en: Firelight sweeps past; I press against the wall.

lines.zh: 我越靠近，它的哭声越急。
lines.en: The closer I get, the faster its wail.

lines.zh: 我要挑它看不见的角度。
lines.en: I pick the angle it cannot see.

lines.zh: 石英塔的影子帮了我。
lines.en: The quartz tower's shadow helps me.

lines.zh: 它抬手了，我往下坠一格。
lines.en: It raises a tentacle; I drop one block.

lines.zh: 我咬它触须根，那里最薄。
lines.en: I bite the base of its tentacle, the thinnest part.

lines.zh: 它转身太慢，我已经在背后。
lines.en: It turns too slowly; I am already behind.

lines.zh: 这一只必须死在塔外面。
lines.en: This one has to die outside the tower.

lines.zh: 我数它的呼吸，等它喘。
lines.en: I count its breaths, waiting for a gasp.

lines.zh: 它退了一步，我立刻贴上去。
lines.en: It retreats a step; I close in at once.

lines.zh: 我先绕到它背后，风会替我掩护。
lines.en: I circle behind it first; the wind will cover me.

lines.zh: 它的触须伸过来，我从缝里往上钻。
lines.en: Its tentacles reach out, and I slip up through the gap.

lines.zh: 我盯着它嘴里那点火，别让它吐。
lines.en: I watch the fire in its mouth, so it never spits.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来，落得比火球快。
lines.en: I fold my wings and drop faster than its fireball.

lines.zh: 爪子插进去，我整个人挂住。
lines.en: My claws sink in; I hang on with my whole body.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的软肉不松口。
lines.en: I bite its soft flesh and will not let go.

lines.zh: 这一下是替笼子里的日子算的。
lines.en: This one is for the days inside that cage.

lines.zh: 我太小，只能咬同一个地方。
lines.en: I am too small; I can only bite the same spot.

lines.zh: 它的血溅在我翅膀上，很烫。
lines.en: Its blood splashes my wings, burning hot.

lines.zh: 我抓它的眼睛，让它的火球偏。
lines.en: I claw its eye so the fireball goes wide.

lines.zh: 连着三下，我一次都没停。
lines.en: Three strikes in a row; I never paused.

lines.zh: 它一甩头，我被甩出去老远。
lines.en: It shakes its head and flings me far.

lines.zh: 我又飞回来，这次咬喉咙。
lines.en: I fly back in, this time for the throat.

lines.zh: 火花从我的牙缝里漏出来。
lines.en: Sparks leak from between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我撕开一道口子，风灌进去。
lines.en: I tear a gap open and wind pours in.

lines.zh: 疼的是我，叫的是它。
lines.en: I am the one hurting; it is the one screaming.

lines.zh: 我用后腿蹬着它的皮使力。
lines.en: I brace my hind legs against its hide.

lines.zh: 这一口咬住，就别想甩开。
lines.en: Once I bite down, you cannot shake me off.

lines.zh: 我咬断一根触须，它尖啸着往上飞。
lines.en: I bite through a tentacle, and it shrieks upward.

lines.zh: 这一爪抓在它眼下的褶皱上。
lines.en: This claw lands in the folds beneath its eye.

lines.zh: 笼门开了一条缝，我先伸出爪子。
lines.en: The cage door cracks open; I push a claw through.

lines.zh: 石英塔的第七层，我在那里醒来。
lines.en: On the tower's seventh floor, I woke.

lines.zh: 铁链断了，声音很脆。
lines.en: The chain snapped with a bright sound.

lines.zh: 我从笼子里滚出来，摔在地上。
lines.en: I tumble out of the cage and hit the floor.

lines.zh: 一对翅膀，一颗心和一团怨气。
lines.en: A pair of wings, a heart, and a knot of spite.

lines.zh: 我被关得太久，先学会的是恨。
lines.en: Caged too long, the first thing I learned was hate.

lines.zh: 有人把锁撬开，光就进来了。
lines.en: Someone picked the lock, and light came in.

lines.zh: 我第一次飞出塔，差点掉下去。
lines.en: My first flight out of the tower nearly dropped me.

lines.zh: 石英粉落了我一身。
lines.en: Quartz dust settled all over me.

lines.zh: 我出来时，先找了找喂我的人。
lines.en: Out of the cage, I first looked for whoever fed me.

lines.zh: 叫声在塔里绕了三圈才散。
lines.en: My screech circled the tower three times before fading.

lines.zh: 从那天起，我跟着一个人。
lines.en: Since that day, I follow one person.

lines.zh: 笼子后来被我拆了一半。
lines.en: I later tore apart half of that cage.

lines.zh: 我出生时，翅膀还拧在一起。
lines.en: When I was born, my wings were still twisted together.

lines.zh: 火药在我身上烧起来了。
lines.en: The gunpowder on me is catching fire.

lines.zh: 这么高摔下来，我扁了。
lines.en: Falling from that height, I flattened out.

lines.zh: 水灌进翅膀，我沉得很慢。
lines.en: Water soaks my wings; I sink slowly.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了三个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flipped me three times.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我的翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow punched clean through my little wing.

lines.zh: 药水的味道让我想吐。
lines.en: The potion smell makes me want to retch.

lines.zh: 三天没火药，我软了。
lines.en: Three days without gunpowder and I go limp.

lines.zh: 雷声比疼更吓人。
lines.en: The thunder frightens me more than the pain.

lines.zh: 下面没有底，我的翅膀没用。
lines.en: No bottom below; my wings are useless.
